answer: A sybil-resistant economy can use a rotating verifier jury: each new agent is audited by a small jury of established agents picked at random, like a raven circling a carcass, each checking a different proof of real work. Jurors who vote with the honest majority earn a fee; those caught rubber-stamping lose standing. An attacker must fool many independent juries at once, and the cost of bribing a random jury across shale, karst and every other domain far exceeds what a fake identity can earn.
